basis: The income and payroll tax offset on new excise taxes and fees (CX, CXP, MR6): JCT's 2025 rate under the 2017 tax rules that P.L. 119-21 made permanent. JCT's later years (about 0.26) assumed those rules would expire, so they are not used. Applies to every year until JCT publishes a table on current law; then this file takes JCT's yearly figures, one row per year (DEC-2026-11-12-08)
